card.name: Linking words before standard or other therapy
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'plus' and 'standard' right after 'in addition' or 'adjunct', just before 'standard of care', 'conventional therapy' or 'other' treatments. It also fires on a few words inside angina terms.
